Cedar Forum 2027: registration terms (excerpt)

4. Attendee data. By registering you agree that your name, job title and company may appear in the Cedar Forum attendee directory, which is visible to other registered attendees. You may opt out of the directory when you register by ticking the box on the pass form.

5. Use of the list. Attendees may not copy, scrape or download directory entries, or use them for bulk marketing. Cedar Forum may email a list of the attendees who opted in to share their details to participating sponsors within 14 days after the event.

6. Refunds. Passes can be transferred to a colleague up to 7 days before the event. Refunds are not available after 30 days before the event.
